headline: HuyenBao v13.9 — collapsible assets, thousand separators, market layout
summary: v13.9: Assets 'own' section now collapses owned items by category (Properties, Vehicles, Watches, Jewelry, Art, Collectibles, Sneakers, Handbags, Audio, Camera, Suits, Other) — each header shows the count + total value and only expands on tap. Tables and detailed displays now use full thousand-separated numbers ($1,234,567) via fmtFull() so values > 100 tỷ stay readable, with wider numeric cells and tabular-nums. Markets tab rebuilt as clean cards: 2-column summary header (Total Value | Total P&L), per-stock card with left (name + price + daily badge + sparkline) + right (holdings + P&L + ROI%) + bottom buy/sell/MAX/All, responsive on mobile.
features: Assets 'own': owned items grouped by category with collapsible headers
Assets 'own': summary header per category (icon + name + count + total value)
Assets 'own': default collapsed — only header shown until tapped
Engine: new fmtFull() — full dollar value with thousand separators
Tables: fmtFull() in Portfolio holdings, transactions, StockTab, Finance Overview, Banking credit breakdown, Assets item rows
Tables: wider numeric cells (min-width 90px, nowrap) + tabular-nums
Markets: 2-column summary card (Total Value | Total P&L + ROI%)
Markets: per-stock clean cards (left name+price+badge+sparkline, right holdings+P&L+ROI)
Markets: buy/sell/MAX/All buttons moved to bottom of card
